Code preserved in metal/ as documented learning only. Wan speedup = lightx2v + distill + LTX routing, not Metal.

phases.title: Wan distill — trained on MPS (frontier), but ABLATION says lightx2v-2step already wins
phases.detail: Differentiable distill TRAINING on Apple Silicon works (frontier, loss 0.62->0.05). BUT ablation (the honesty check): plain lightx2v @2-step LPIPS=0.023 vs our distill LoRA @2-step LPIPS=0.047 — our LoRA ADDS drift, doesn't remove it. lightx2v already nails 2-step. LoRA loads/applies correctly (converter works), it's just not a good LoRA. USABLE WIN: run lightx2v at --steps 2 (~1.6x faster, LPIPS 0.023, no custom training). Next: test if 1-step breaks lightx2v (where a custom distill could actually add value).

phases.title: Step-count map (measured, honest)
phases.detail: LPIPS vs 4-step baseline @832x480: 2-step lightx2v=0.023 PASS (~1.6x, ship as fast mode); 2-step+our distill=0.047 (LoRA hurts); 1-step lightx2v=1.09 FAIL (total collapse). Conclusion: 2-step solved by lightx2v free; 1-step is the only niche for a custom distill and needs a consistency/rCM loss (not naive MSE), data-center-hard. Custom distill = flagged R&D, not blocking.
